basis: Saia’s July 28 earnings release was the earliest verified public issuer communication establishing the decline. Its consolidated statements of operations report Q2 2023 operating revenue of $694,622,000 against $745,554,000 for Q2 2022. Both figures come from the same quarterly row for Saia, Inc. and subsidiaries. Actual revenue was $13,654,300 below the $708,276,300 threshold. The earlier quarterly outlook gave a direction for sequential revenue growth but no upper bound.

coverage.detail: February 3, preceding earnings cycle. Saia reported Q4 2022 revenue of $655.7 million and supplied no Q2 2023 consolidated revenue forecast.
On the February 3 call, management discussed softer freight volumes, contractual pricing and uncertainty about customer demand. It gave no numeric upper bound for Q2 revenue.
The March 2 operating update covered January and February LTL shipments, tonnage and weight per shipment. Its figures concern Q1 freight activity.
April 28, immediately preceding earnings release. Saia reported Q1 revenue of $660.5 million, down 0.1% year over year. It gave no Q2 consolidated revenue range.

On the April 28 public call, furnished May 4, CFO Doug Col expected Q2 revenue to rise from Q1. That direction allowed outcomes on either side of $708,276,300. His possible 100-basis-point sequential improvement referred to the operating ratio.
Saia’s Q1 investor presentation shows $661 million in the rounded 2023 quarterly revenue table and leaves the Q2 cell blank. Its quantified 2023 spending outlook covers capital expenditures.

The May 23 Wolfe conference agenda lists Saia’s CEO and says press attendance was restricted. The agenda contains no forecast. I found no public Saia webcast, transcript or release of remarks from that session.

June 2, Q2 operating update. April and May LTL shipments per workday fell 5.7% and 4.2% year over year, respectively. Tonnage per workday fell 1.1% and 2.0%. These two months of freight data establish no ceiling on full-quarter consolidated revenue.

The host’s June 7–8 Boston roadshow notice names Saia’s CEO and CFO and directs investors to arrange meetings through a sales representative. It contains no financial guidance. I found no public issuer release of remarks from those meetings.

July 28 actuals. Saia’s IR release identifies the comparison as Q2 2023 versus Q2 2022 and reports a 6.8% revenue decline. The consolidated table in Exhibit 99.1 supplies the amounts to the nearest thousand dollars.
The original wire distribution identifies Saia, Inc. as the source and timestamps publication at 7:30 a.m. Eastern on July 28, before the 11 a.m. results call.

publication_date_evidence: Saia’s IR release and SEC Exhibit 99.1 both carry a July 28, 2023 dateline. The issuer-originated wire release independently records public distribution on July 28 at 7:30 a.m. Eastern.
